required.name: org-name
required.label: Name
required.why: The agent needs the name of the business at this location, not the name of the chain that owns it.

required.name: address
required.label: Address
required.why: An address is what turns an answer into a visit, and it is the fact most often left as an image on a map.

required.name: hours
required.label: Opening hours
required.why: The agent answers "are they open" from the hours table; a graphic of the same hours answers nothing.

required.name: phone
required.label: Phone
required.why: The phone number is the fallback path for everything the page does not cover, and the user will ask for it.

recommended.name: email
recommended.label: Email
recommended.why: Gives the agent a written channel for requests that a phone call cannot leave a record of.

recommended.name: service-area
recommended.label: Service area
recommended.why: Tells the agent whether the user's address is somewhere this location will actually travel to.

recommended.name: primary-action-url
recommended.label: Booking or contact link
recommended.why: Gives the agent one link to hand over when the user says yes, instead of a homepage to search.

recommended.name: description
recommended.label: Description
recommended.why: Says what this location does, so the agent can rule it in or out before reading any further.
